items.c2: Look — I take shelter in You, Śambhu. Supreme. No beginning. One. You're in everything that moves and stands still, living in every heart. You house it all, innit.

choices.why: the turn itself; refuge opens, nothing before it
image kept, referent shown inside the compound

items.sanskrit: paraṃ parasthaṃ gahanād anādim | sarvālayaṃ sarvacarācarasthaṃ tvām eva śambhuṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye

items.c2: Man was getting spun in the sorrow-wheel — womb to tomb, the full journey — and asked the Lord, the Support Himself: what's the highest truth?

choices.why: whirled as losing footing, not travelling
the verse's own endpoints, kept whole
epithet kept; He is asked AS support

items.sanskrit: garbhādhivāsapūrvakamaraṇāntakaduḥkhacakravibhrāntaḥ | ādhāram bhagavantaṃ śiṣyaḥ papraccha paramārtham

items.c2: So the teacher answered in support-verses, gave him the essence straight. And Abhinavagupta's telling it again now, Śaiva view. Same teaching, second telling.

choices.why: retelling is a present act, not a past event

items.sanskrit: ādhārakārikābhiḥ taṃ gurur abhibhāṣati sma tatsāram | kathayaty abhinavaguptaḥ śivaśāsanadṛṣṭiyogena

items.c2: By the sheer weight of His own power and glory, the Lord put out this fourfold egg — power, Māyā, nature, earth. In that order.

choices.why: weight as the cause, glory as its shine

items.sanskrit: nijaśaktivaibhavabharād a.ṅdacatuṣṭayam idaṃ vibhāgena | śaktir māyā prakṛtiḥ pṛthvī ceti prabhāvitaṃ prabhuṇā

items.c2: Inside all that, the world's running — bodies, faculties, worlds. And man in the middle of it, wearing a body? That's Śiva. Tied up, not done out.

choices.why: MLE everyman pronoun; the bhoktā is generic

items.sanskrit: tatrāntar viśvam idaṃ vicitratanukaraṇabhuvanasaṃtānam | bhoktā ca tatra dehī śiva eva gṛhītapaśubhāvaḥ

items.c2: He wears god, man, beast, plant — none of it sticks to Him. Clean throughout.
items.sanskrit: nānāvidhavarṇānāṃ rūpaṃ dhatte yathāmalaḥ sphaṭikaḥ | suramānuṣapaśupādaparūpatvaṃ tadvad īśo 'pi

items.c2: He moves and rests right along with the whole lot — bodies, faculties, worlds.

choices.why: the carryover named; accompaniment, not identity
mass as the full set, nothing excluded

items.sanskrit: gacchati gacchati jala iva himakarabimbaṃ sthite sthitiṃ yāti | tanukaraṇabhuvanavarge tathāyam ātmā maheśānaḥ

items.c2: You won't see Him direct — He's unseen, everywhere. You catch Him where your mind catches things, you get me?
items.sanskrit: rāhur adṛśyo 'pi yathā śaśibimbasthaḥ prakāśate tadvat | sarvagato 'py ayam ātmā viṣayāśrayaṇena dhīmukure

items.c2: Clean the lens, the face shows. His grace does the wiping — then the self shines through, made of light.

choices.why: grace-descent does the work, not effort
the self shines; nobody shines it

items.sanskrit: ādarśe malarahite yadvad vadanaṃ vibhāti tadvat ayam | śivaśaktipātavimale dhītattve bhāti bhārūpaḥ

items.c2: Made of light. Complete. Resting in Himself — total bliss. Will, knowing, action, all loaded, all endless. Dun know.

choices.why: filled as fully stocked, nothing missing
the arrival was already true; closing seal, opens nothing

items.sanskrit: bhārūpaṃ paripūrṇam svātmani viśrāntito mahānandam | icchasaṃvitkaraṇair nirbharitam anantaśaktiparipūrṇam

items.c2: Clear of every thought — pure, calm, past rising and setting. And in that supreme principle? The whole world shines. Thirty-six natures, all of it.

choices.why: shining kept active; world as subject

items.sanskrit: sarvavikalpavihīnaṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ layodayavihīnam | yat paratattvaṃ tasmin vibhāti ṣaṭṭriṃśadātma jagat

items.c2: Look at a mirror — towns and villages inside it, all different, none of it split. Each one separate, each from the next, and all of it from the mirror too.

choices.why: the ground named as source alongside mutuality

items.sanskrit: darpaṇabimbe yadvan nagaragrāmādicitram avibhāgi | bhāti vibhāgenaiva ca parasparaṃ darpaṇād api ca

items.c2: Same deal from the purest knowing of supreme Bhairava — void of division, yet the world shows up divided. Each from each, and from that knowing too.

choices.why: the carryover named; same structure, higher ground
emptiness of division stated before the division

items.sanskrit: vimalatamaparamabhairavabodhāt tadvad vibhāgaśūnyam api | anyonyaṃ ca tato 'pi ca vibhaktam ābhāti jagad etat

items.c2: Śiva. Power. Sadāśiva. Then Īśvara and Vidyā, made principle-states. He lights all five powers, each in its own nature.

choices.why: illumines as switching on, kept active

items.sanskrit: śivaśaktisadāśivatām īśvaravidyāmayīṃ ca tattvadaśām | śaktīnāṃ pañcānāṃ vibhaktabhāvena bhāsayati

items.c2: Supreme is the freedom that pulls off the hard thing — the great Lord's own. And the goddess, Māyā-power? She veils Śiva's own self. That's the whole of it.

choices.why: effecting-the-difficult as pulled off; kept bare per Tier 3
veiling as covering act, goddess as agent

items.sanskrit: paramaṃ yat svātantryaṃ durghaṭasaṃpādanaṃ maheśasya | devī māyāśaktiḥ svātmāvaraṇaṃ śivasya itat

items.c2: Grabbed by Māyā, knowing goes stained. Man turns beast — fettered by time, art, limit, and by passion and ignorance holding him down.

choices.why: becoming, not being — the fall as event
two bindings named: power-over and bound-state

items.sanskrit: māyāparigrahavaśād bodho malinaḥ pumān paśur bhavati | kālakalāniyatibalād rāgāvidyāvaśena saṃbaddhaḥ

items.c2: Right now? Man knows next to nothing — with his whole self, that's the size of it. Six sheaths with Māyā, innermost limbs of the atom. Said plain.

choices.why: temporal honesty; knowing dated to the present
a-little kept small, no false modesty
stated, closer; so-it-is-said rendered as said

items.sanskrit: adhunaiva kiṃcid evedam eva sarvātmanaiva jānāmi | māyāsahitaṃ kañcukaṣaṭkam aṇor antaraṅgam idam uktam

items.c2: Separate from Him, but never apart — like husk on the grain. He gets clean by turning to Śiva's path and wanting it.
items.sanskrit: kambukam iva ta.ṅdulakaṇaviniviṣṭaṃ bhinnam apy abhidā | bhajate tat tu viśuddhiṃ śivamārgaunmukhyayogena

items.c2: Pleasure, pain, delusion — that's all there is to it, coming off resolve, will, and I-sense. Then nature. Then the inner organ: intellect, mind, ego, in that order.

choices.term: that's all there is to it
choices.why: mere-ness as cap; nothing behind the three

items.sanskrit: sukhaduḥkhamohamātraṃ niścayasaṃkalpanābhimānāc ca | prakṛtir athāntaḥkaranaṃ buddhimano'haṃkṛtikramaśaḥ

items.c2: Ears, skin, eyes, tongue, nose — the knowing organs, for sound and the rest. Voice, hands, feet, anus, privates — the doing organs.

choices.why: action-organs as doers; list complete, nothing softened

items.sanskrit: śrotraṃ tvagakṣirasanā ghrāṇaṃ buddhīndriyāṇi śabdādau | vākpāṇipādapāyūpasthaṃ karmendriyāṇi punaḥ

items.c2: What they catch is subtle stuff, no divisions in it — the five tanmātras: sound, touch, form, taste, smell.
items.sanskrit: eṣāṃ grāhyo viṣayaḥ sūkṣmaḥ pravibhāgavarjito yaḥ syāt | tanmātrapañcakaṃ tat śabdaḥ sparśo maho raso gandhaḥ

items.c2: Mix those up and the object goes gross — five elements: sky, wind, fire, water, earth.
items.sanskrit: etatsaṃsargavaśāt sthūlo viṣayas tu bhūtapañcakatām | abhyeti nabhaḥ pavanas tejaḥ salilaṃ ca pṛthvī ca

items.c2: Like husk over the grain, creation covers from nature on down. All the way to earth, consciousness wears a body.

choices.why: nature-first as top of the covering order

items.sanskrit: tuṣa iva ta.ṅdulakaṇikām āvṛṇute prakṛtipūrvakaḥ sargaḥ | pṛthvīparyanto 'yaṃ caitanyaṃ dehabhāvena

items.c2: Top covering: the impurity here. Subtle — the Māyā sheath and the rest. Gross — the outer body-form. Three sheaths wrapped round the self, innit.

choices.why: supreme-covering as highest layer named first
count kept as stated; no reconciliation invented

items.sanskrit: param āvaraṇaṃ mala iha sūkṣmaṃ māyādikañcukaṃ sthūlam | bāhyaṃ vigraharūpaṃ kośatrayaveṣṭito hy ātmā

items.c2: Joined to the darkness of ignorance, the one self — still one in its own nature — sees itself as many. Grasper, grasped, every which way.

choices.why: oneness held against the manifold seeing
perceiving kept active; self as its own object

items.sanskrit: ajñānatimirayogād ekam api svaṃ svabhāvam ātmānam | grāhyagrāhakanānāvaicitryeṇāvabudhyeta

items.c2: Like juice sitting in molasses, sugar, lumps, the lot — all divided states sit in the supreme self, Śambhu.

choices.why: named full; Śambhu kept as His name

items.sanskrit: rasaphāṇitaśarkarikāguḍakha.ṅdādyā yathekṣurasa eva | tadvad avasthā bhedāḥ sarve paramātmanaḥ śambhoḥ

items.c2: Knower. Inner ruler. Breath. The All. Body, birth, the lot. All just convention — in truth, not a bit of it.

choices.why: list closed with the lump-term; individuals as lumps

items.sanskrit: vijñānāntaryāmiprāṇavirāḍdehajātipi.ṅdāntāḥ | vyavahāramātram etat paramārthena tu na santy eva

items.c2: No snake in the rope. But the fear kills right up to death. Nobody can size up how strong delusion is.

choices.why: absence stated flat; the example's whole work
fear's reach dated to the end

items.sanskrit: rajjvāṃ nāsti bhujaṅgas trāsaṃ kurute ca mṛtyuparyantam | bhrānter mahatī śaktir na vivektuṃ śakyate nāma

items.c2: Right and wrong. Heaven and hell. Birth, death, pleasure, pain. Caste, life-stage, the rest. None of it's real in the self — but delusion's force puts it all up.

choices.why: delusion-force as builder; arising as erected

items.sanskrit: tadvad dharmādharmasvarnirayotpattimaraṇasukhaduḥkham | varṇāśramādi cātmany asad api vibhramabalād bhavati

items.c2: This is that darkness right here. It shines in things — and the 'I'm not the self' thought shows up even where the self can't be topped.

choices.why: demonstratives doubled; darkness located, not abstract

items.sanskrit: etat tad andhakāraṃ yad bhāveṣu prakāśamānatayā | ātmānatirikteṣv api bhavaty anātmābhimāno 'yam

items.c2: Darkness on darkness: taking body, breath, the rest — not-self, taken for self.

choices.payload: sphoṭa, kept as stated, referent unresolved (Tier 3)
choices.why: honest drop: image without stack referent; doctrine (mistaking) carried fully

items.sanskrit: timirād api timiram idaṃ ga.ṅdasyopari mahān ayaṃ sphoṭaḥ | yad anātmany api dehaprāṇadāv ātmamānitvam

items.c2: Body, breath, reflection, mind, knowing, open sky — join all that and the self ties itself in a net. Mad. Like the net-maker.

choices.why: wonder rendered as mad — astonishment kept street
spider unnamed; trade named; Tier 1 kept

items.sanskrit: dehaprāṇavimarśanadhījñānanabhaḥprapañcayogena | ātmānam veṣṭayate citraṃ jālena jālakāra iva

items.c2: Join your own shining glory of knowing and unwrap yourself. That's how supreme Śiva puts on the mad play of bondage and release.

choices.why: unwrapping as reversal of v32's tying
wondrous-play kept mad; wonder shared with v32

items.sanskrit: svajñānavibhavabhāsanayogenodveṣṭayet nijātmānam | iti bandhamokṣacitrāṃ krīḍāṃ pratanoti paramaśivaḥ

items.c2: Creating, keeping, dissolving. Waking, dreaming, deep sleep. All of it shines in there, in the fourth house. And still He shines through it all, unveiled.

choices.why: abode kept; fourth as address, not rank

items.sanskrit: sṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārā jāgratsvapnau suṣuptam iti tasmin | bhānti turīye dhāmani tathāpi tair nāvṛtaṃ bhāti

items.c2: Waking's the universe, through difference. Dreaming's the shine, through light's glory. The knower's the deep-sleep state, through massed knowing. Past all that: the fourth.

choices.why: beyond stated after the three told fully
knowing-mass as solid block, kept dense
each state assigned its domain, no blur

items.sanskrit: jāgrad viśvaṃ bhedāt svapnas tejaḥ prakāśamāhātmyāt | prājñaḥ suptāvasthā jñānaghanatvāt tataḥ paraṃ turyam

items.c2: Cloud, smoke, dust — none of it soils the sky. Same way, Māyā's deformings don't touch the supreme person.

choices.why: changes named as warps; Māyā's work distorted, not neutral

items.sanskrit: jaladharadhūmarajobhir malinīkriyate yathā na gaganatalam | tadvan māyāvikṛtibhir aparāmṛṣṭaḥ paraḥ puruṣaḥ

items.c2: One jar's sky gets dusty, the rest stay clean. Same with souls — each enjoys its own pleasure and pain.
items.sanskrit: ekasmin ghaṭagagane rajasā vyāpte bhavanti nānyāni | malināni tadvad ete jīvāḥ sukhaduḥkhabhedajuṣaḥ

items.c2: Calm around him, he's calm. Glad around him, he's glad. That's man deluded. But the Lord, among the principles? Never like that, not in truth.

choices.why: states as weather around the fool
everyman pronoun; the fool is generic

items.sanskrit: śānte śānta ivāyaṃ hṛṣṭe hṛṣṭo vimohavati mūḍhaḥ | tattvagaṇe sati bhagavān na punaḥ paramārthataḥ sa tathā

items.c2: First, wipe the shine of His form off what isn't Him. Then the supreme self smashes the 'not-Him' delusion inside yourself.

choices.why: removal as wiping; gerund as first job
non-self as plain negation, quoted as thought

items.sanskrit: yad anātmany api tadrūpāvabhāsanaṃ tat purā nirākṛtya | ātmany anātmarūpāṃ bhrāntiṃ vidalayati paramātmā

items.c2: Goal got, delusion-pair cut at the root — after that, the top yogin never weighs up other duties. Done asking what's next.
items.sanskrit: itthaṃ vibhramayugalakasamūlavicchedane kṛtārthasya | kartavyāntarakalanā na jātu parayogino bhavati

items.c2: Earth, nature, Māyā — three fallen into known shape. Stare nondual at them and the lot goes back to bare being.
items.sanskrit: pṛthivī prakṛtir māyā tritayam idaṃ vedyarūpatāpatitam | advaitabhāvanabalād bhavati hi sanmātrapariśeṣam

items.c2: Girdle, earring, bracelet — drop the differences and all you see is gold. Same here: drop difference, all shines as bare being.

choices.why: difference-leaving as the single move, twice

items.sanskrit: raśanāku.ṅdalakaṭakaṃ bhedatyāgena dṛśyate yathā hema | tadvad bhedatyāge sanmātraṃ sarvam ābhāti

items.c2: That brahman — supreme, pure, calm, nondual to the core, even, whole, deathless, true — rests in shining-formed power.
items.sanskrit: tad brahma paraṃ śuddhaṃ śāntaṃ abhedātmakaṃ samaṃ sakalam | amṛtaṃ satyaṃ śaktau viśrāmyati bhāsvarūpāyām

items.c2: Wanted, known, done — all by the shining-formed. Untouched. Yet it takes on sky-flower status: what can't be.

choices.why: the image decoded in-line, Tier 2 visible

items.sanskrit: iṣyata iti vedyata iti saṃpādyata iti ca bhāsvarūpeṇa | aparāmṛṣṭaṃ yad api tu nabhaḥprasūnatvam abhyeti

items.c2: Grab power's trident and the god of gods lets out the whole — in the supreme Lord, in the Śiva-name, in the highest truth.

choices.why: emission as letting-out, god as agent

items.sanskrit: śaktitriśūlaparigamayogena samastam api parameśe | śivanāmani paramārthe visṛjyate devadevena

items.c2: And again — by the five powers spreading in order, the outer got its self outside, and out came that varied three of eggs.
items.sanskrit: punar api ca pañcaśaktiprasaraṇakrameṇa bahir api tat | a.ṅdatrayaṃ vicitraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ bahirātmalābhena

items.c2: So I drive the power-wheel, the machine — playstyle. Me, god, pure-formed, sitting in the seat of the lord of the great power-wheel.

choices.why: driving as ongoing handling, causative kept

items.sanskrit: iti śakticakrayantraṃ krīḍāyogena vāhayan devaḥ | aham eva śuddharūpaḥ śaktimahācakranāyakapadasthaḥ

items.c2: In Me the whole universe shines — jars and the lot in a spotless mirror. From Me everything spreads — dream-variety from a sleeper.

choices.why: dream as emanation-mode, image mapped not dropped

items.sanskrit: mayy eva bhāti viśvaṃ darpaṇa iva nirmale ghatādīni | mattaḥ prasarati sarvaṃ svapnavicitratvam iva suptāt

items.c2: I am the universe-formed — hands, feet, the whole nature set, as my body. And I shine in everything, light-natured.

choices.why: first-person shining kept; no passive dodge

items.sanskrit: aham eva viśvarūpaḥ karacaranādisvabhāva iva dehaḥ | sarvasmin aham eva sphurāmi bhāveṣu bhāsvarūpam iva

items.c2: Seer. Hearer. Smeller. No body, no senses — and no doer neither. Still, the systems, the texts, the reasonings, all the varied lot? I put them together.

choices.why: non-doer doubled; grammar bends, claim holds

items.sanskrit: draṣṭā śrotā ghrātā dehendriyavarjito 'py akartāpi | siddhāntāgamatarkāṃś citrān aham eva racayāmi

items.c2: That's it — duality-thought dissolved, the enchanting Māyā stepped over. Like water in water, milk in milk: melt into brahman.

choices.why: crossing kept striding; Māyā not fought, passed
dissolving kept liquid; optative as invitation

items.sanskrit: itthaṃ dvaitavikalpe galite pravilaṅghya mohinīṃ māyām | salile salilaṃ kṣīre kṣīram iva brahmaṇi layī syāt

items.c2: Same way — get to Śiva-madeness by contemplation, in the host of principles. What sorrow then? What delusion? You're looking at brahman in everything.

choices.why: beholder's view stated as universal sight

items.sanskrit: itthaṃ tattvasamūhe bhāvanayā śivamayatvam abhiyāte | kaḥ śokaḥ ko mohaḥ sarvaṃ brahmāvalokayataḥ

items.c2: Good or bad, the fruit of deeds comes only off contact with false knowing. And contact's fault is peak — like rolling with a thief when you ain't one.
items.sanskrit: karmaphalaṃ śubham aśubhaṃ mithyājñānena saṃgamād eva | viṣamo hi saṅgadoṣas taskarayogo 'py ataskarasyeva

items.c2: The ones who run world-convention and nurse ignorance here? Fools. They go birth to death, bolted by duty's locks.

choices.why: tending ignorance as nursing it along
duty-locks as bolts; bound state kept hard

items.sanskrit: lokavyavahārakṛtāṃ ya ihāvidyām upāsate mūḍhāḥ | te yānti janmamṛtyū dharmādharmārgalābaddhāḥ

items.c2: But even duty-made deeds, heaped up in ignorance-time, stacked long like cotton — they burn off in the knowing-flame.

choices.why: flame of knowing as the instrument named

items.sanskrit: ajñānakālanicitam dharmādharmātmakaṃ tu karmāpi | cirasaṃcitam iva tūlaṃ naśyati vijñānadīptivaśāt

items.c2: Done, but not for fruit — so where's birth coming from? Birth-bond gone and done with: the Śiva-sun shines by its own rays.

choices.why: self-light as instrument, no borrowed shine

items.sanskrit: jñānaprāptau kṛtam api na phalāya tato 'sya janma katham | gatajanmabandhayogo bhāti śivārkaḥ svadīdhitibhiḥ

items.c2: Seed stripped of husk, cover, bran — it ain't sprouting. Same self, free of atom, Māyā, deed? No rebirth sprout.
items.sanskrit: tuṣakambukakiṃśārukamuktaṃ bījaṃ yathāṅkuraṃ kurute | naiva tathāṇavamāyākarmavimukto bhavāṅkuraṃ hy ātmā

items.c2: Man who knows the self fears nowhere — everything's his own form. And he never grieves, since in truth nothing's perished. Ever.
items.sanskrit: ātmajño na kutaścana bibheti sarvaṃ hi tasya nijarūpam | naiva ca śocati yasmāt paramārthe nāśitā nāsti

items.c2: Out of the heart-treasury, locked secret — truth-jewels heaped and sprouted. 'I indeed.' In the great-Lord state — what misfortune? Whose?

choices.why: self-claim quoted verbatim; no paraphrase dare

items.sanskrit: atigūḍhahṛdayagañjaprarūḍhaparamārtharatnasaṃcayataḥ | aham eveti maheśvarabhāve kā durgatiḥ kasya

items.c2: Liberation's got no address. No going elsewhere neither. Cut ignorance's knot and your own power showing up — that's liberation.

choices.why: double negative kept street; travel refused

items.sanskrit: mokṣasya naiva kiṃcid dhāmāsti na cāpi gamanam anyatra | ajñānagranthibhidā svaśaktyabhivyaktatā mokṣaḥ

items.c2: Knot cut. Doubt gone. Delusion binned. Merit and demerit spent. Body on — still free.

choices.why: delusion thrown out, not argued down
yoked-to-body kept worn; freedom inside it

items.sanskrit: bhinnājñānagranthir gatasaṃdehaḥ parākṛtabhrāntiḥ | prakṣīṇapuṇyapāpo vigrahayoge 'py asau muktaḥ

items.c2: Seed that fire got won't sprout. Same deal: deeds burnt by knowing-fire don't give birth no more.

choices.why: seized by fire; inflammation as capture

items.sanskrit: agnyabhidagdhaṃ bījaṃ yathā prarohāsamarthatām eti | jñānāgnidagdham evaṃ karma na janmapradaṃ bhavati

items.c2: Small mind pictures a body to fit its deeds. Body drops — knowing comes out contracted, shining just that wide.

choices.why: shining narrowed; width fitted to deeds

items.sanskrit: parimitabuddhitvena hi karmocitabhāvidehabhāvanayā | saṅkucitā citir etaddehadhvaṃse tathā bhāti

items.c2: But if knowing's stainless — all-transcended, knower and doer both, spread out, light-formed with no setting nor rising, true-resolved...

choices.why: if-clause left open; nothing smuggled after it

items.sanskrit: yadi punar amalaṃ bodhaṃ sarvasamuttīrnaboddhṛkartṛmayam | vitatam anastamitoditabhārūpam satyasaṃkalpam

items.c2: Past direction, time, and touch. Firm. Can't change. The full Lord — the one boss making and breaking hosts of powers.

choices.why: beyond rendered as gone-past; limits behind
sole-maker as the one in charge

items.sanskrit: dikkālakalanavikalaṃ dhruvam avyayam īśvaraṃ suparipūrṇam | bahutaraśaktivrātapralayodayaviracanaikakartāram

items.c2: Wake up to yourself as Śiva-made — the one who writes creation's rules. How you gonna wander after that? Spread everywhere — from where? To where? What refuge?
items.sanskrit: sṛṣṭyādividhisuvedhasam ātmānaṃ śivamayaṃ vibudhyeta | katham iva saṃsārī syād vitatasya kutaḥ kva vā saraṇam

items.c2: Proved by reason: the knower's deeds bear no fruit. 'Not mine, this — His.' Hold that firm. No fruit in this world.

choices.why: reasons plural kept; no number invented

items.sanskrit: iti yuktibhir api siddhaṃ yatkarma jñānino na saphalaṃ tat | na mamedam api tu tasyeti dārḍhyato na hi phalaṃ loke

items.c2: So: wake up, let contemplation blow through, chuck every thought in the blazing self-flame — and turn flame yourself.
items.sanskrit: itthaṃ sakalavikalpān pratibuddho bhāvanāsamīraṇataḥ | ātmajyotiṣi dīpte juhvaj jyotirmayo bhavati

items.c2: Eats this or that. Wears whatever. Calm. Lives anywhere. The self of all beings is freed.
items.sanskrit: aśnan yad vā tad vā saṃvīto yena kenacic chāntaḥ | yatra kvacana nivāsī vimucyate sarvabhūtātmā

items.c2: Horse-rites by the hundred thousand, brahmin-killings by the hundred thousand — the truth-knower? Merit can't touch him. Demerit can't touch him. Stainless.

choices.why: extremes counted, not rounded; scale kept
untouched kept physical; both sides refused

items.sanskrit: hayamedhaśatasahasrāṇy api kurute brahmaghātalakṣāṇi | paramārthavit na puṇyair na ca pāpaiḥ spṛśyate vimalaḥ

items.c2: Leave pride, joy, anger, lust, sorrow, fear, greed, delusion. No praise songs. No vaṣaṭs. Move dull-looking, opinion-free.

choices.why: hymns as songs; genre kept musical

items.sanskrit: madaharṣakopamanmathaviṣādabhayalobhamohaparivarjī | niḥstotravaṣaṭkāro jaḍa iva vicared avādamatiḥ

items.c2: Pride, joy, the whole gang — they rise out of difference-delusion. So how's any of that gonna touch the one awake to the nondual self?

choices.why: host as crew; pride-joy plus hangers-on

items.sanskrit: madaharṣaprabhṛtir ayaṃ vargaḥ prabhavati vibhedasaṃmohāt | advaitātmavibodhas tena kathaṃ spṛśyatāṃ nāma

items.c2: Nothing to praise, nothing to offer — nothing standing apart from Him, full stop. Praise pleases him, he's freed — then no bowing, no vaṣaṭs.
items.sanskrit: stutyaṃ vā hotavyaṃ nāsti vyatiriktam asya kiṃcana ca | stotrādinā sa tuṣyen muktas tan nirnamaskṛtivaṣaṭkaḥ

items.c2: Thirty-six principles carried. Full-eyed in the making of the body. His god-house? His own body or someone else's — jar and the lot.

choices.why: window-eyed kept; referent unresolved, no invention

items.sanskrit: ṣaṭtriṃśattattvabhṛtaṃ vigraharacanāgavākṣaparipūrṇam | nijam anyad atha śarīraṃ ghaṭādi vā tasya devagṛham

items.c2: And there she sits — supreme Bhairava-Śiva's own goddess, yoked to her power — worshipped with pure gifts from his own hands.

choices.why: goddess as His own, supreme kept
power-yoked as harnessed, not owned apart

items.sanskrit: tatra ca paramātmamahābhairavaśivadevatāṃ svaśaktiyutām | ātmāmarśanavimaladravyaiḥ paripūjayann āste

items.c2: Chuck the whole heap — outer, inner, fancied differences, the lot — in his blazing knowing-fire. No effort. That's the offering.
items.sanskrit: bahirantaraparikalpanabhedamahābījanicayam arpayataḥ | tasyātidīptasaṃvijjvalane yatnād vinā bhavati homaḥ

items.c2: Meditation that never sets: the blessed Lord keeps creating varied forms. And that's the meditation — true-formed as fancy draws it.
items.sanskrit: dhyānam anastamitaṃ punar eṣa hi bhagavān vicitrarūpāṇi | sṛjati tad eva dhyānaṃ saṃkalpālikhitasatyarūpatvam

items.c2: World-rows, principle-patterns, sense-hosts — he turns the lot in inner knowing. And that's called his muttering.

choices.why: muttering kept low; called, not named

items.sanskrit: bhuvanāvalīṃ samastāṃ tattvakramakalpanām athākṣagaṇam | antarbodhe parivartayati ca yat so 'sya japa uditaḥ

items.c2: Sees it all dead even. Calls knowing enough. Loves the burning-ground world. Holds his body like a skull-staff.

choices.why: evenness kept absolute; dead as total
implement kept; Kaula gear is literal, not image

items.sanskrit: sarvaṃ samayā dṛṣṭyā yat paśyati yac ca saṃvidaṃ manute | viśvaśmaśānaniratāṃ vigrahakhaṭvāṅgakalpanākalitām

items.c2: Tastes the world-essence drink from the known-bit bowl, held in his own hand, filled to the top. That's the vow — hardest to get, easiest to hold.

choices.term: hardest to get, easiest to hold
choices.why: both poles kept; vow as paradox held open

items.sanskrit: viśvarasāsavapūrṇaṃ nijakaragaṃ vedyakha.ṅdakakapālam | rasayati ca yat tad etad vratam asya sudurlabhaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca

items.c2: So: free of birth and death, named truth's great Lord. Got it. And by the finder's shining — done and done, standing as he likes.

choices.why: having-got as got; attainment as catch

items.sanskrit: iti janmanāśahīnaṃ paramārthamaheśvarākhyam upalabhya | upalabdhṛtāprakāśāt kṛtakṛtyas tiṣṭhati yatheṣṭam

items.c2: Pervading, like they said. All-self. Shook off the many. Bliss with no peer, top shelf. Know that and you're made of it.
items.sanskrit: vyāpinam abhihitam itthaṃ sarvātmānaṃ vidhūtanānātvam | nirupamaparamānandaṃ yo vetti sa tanmayo bhavati

items.c2: Shrine or doss-house for outcastes — memory gone either way — drop the body and you're free on the spot, knowing and freedom same time. Off to isolation. Sorrow dead.
items.sanskrit: tīrthe śvapacagṛhe vā naṣṭasmṛtir api parityajan deham | jñānasamakālamuktaḥ kaivalyaṃ yāti hataśokaḥ

items.c2: Shrine-time earns merit. Doss-death buys hell. But with zero stain of merit or demerit on you — what's any of that to you?
items.sanskrit: puṇyāya tīrthasevā nirayāya śvapacasadananidhanagatiḥ | puṇyāpuṇyakalaṅkasparśābhāve tu kiṃ tena

items.c2: Rice pulled clean from husk and bran, tossed back among the husks — it never goes back to being one with them. Ever.
items.sanskrit: tuṣakambukasupṛthakkṛtata.ṅdulakaṇatuṣadalāntarakṣepaḥ | ta.ṅdulakaṇasya kurute na punas tadrūpatādātmyam

items.c2: Same deal: knowing peeled from the sheath-curtain, standing here on impressions — the freed self comes out untouched by that touch.

choices.why: separated as peeled off; tadvat carried

items.sanskrit: tadvat kañcukapaṭalīpṛthakkṛtā saṃvid atra saṃskārāt | tiṣṭhanty api muktātmā tatsparśavivarjitā bhavati

items.c2: Stained gem in a box — best craftsman's flawless finish on the setting. Cut the setting and the truth shows clear.

choices.why: condition as mount; gem held by it

items.sanskrit: kuśalatamaśilpikalpitavimalībhāvaḥ samudgakopādheḥ | malino 'pi maṇir upādheḥ vicchede svacchaparamārthaḥ

items.c2: Same: the pure state the true teacher taught — feeling the body on, freed of every other bind — shines out Śiva-formed.

choices.why: pure-state kept as the thing taught

items.sanskrit: evaṃ sadguruśāsanavimalasthiti vedanaṃ tanūpādheḥ | muktam apy upādhyantaraśūnyam ivābhāti śivarūpam

items.c2: Scripture backs it, faith don't shake — become that. Got it before heaven, hell, or being human.
items.sanskrit: śāstrādiprāmāṇyād avicalitaśraddhayāpi tanmayatām | prāptaḥ sa eva pūrvaṃ svargaṃ narakaṃ manuṣyatvam

items.c2: Last moment, feeding a merit or demerit state — for fools it plays helper. But going on? No cause there.

choices.why: moment feeds a state; kept tending
helper-role scoped to fools; knowers exempt
cause refused; helper is not maker

items.sanskrit: antyaḥ kṣaṇas tu tasmin puṇyāṃ pāpāṃ ca vā sthitiṃ puṣyan | mūḍhānāṃ sahakārībhāvaṃ gacchati gatau tu na sa hetuḥ

items.c2: Beast, bird, creeper, the lot — whoever knows that self-ness goes his own way. Old awakening stamped in, they get there.
items.sanskrit: ye 'pi tadātmatvena viduḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpādayaḥ svagatim | te 'pi purātanasaṃbodhasaṃskṛtās tāṃ gatiṃ yānti

items.c2: Heaven-built, hell-built — man's between bodies right now. That breaks and he links to the next body that fits.
items.sanskrit: svargamayo nirayamayas tad ayaṃ dehāntarālagaḥ puruṣaḥ | tadbhaṅge svaucityād dehāntarayogam abhyeti

items.c2: The self shone for him once, in knowing-time — same shine when the body drops. Otherwise? Never.
items.sanskrit: evaṃ jñānāvasare svātmā sakṛd asya yādṛg avabhātaḥ | tādṛśa eva tadāsau na dehapāte 'nyathā bhavati

items.c2: Senses robbed. Memory gone. Breath choked. Cut off. Vitals hurting. Enjoyment running on body-impressions.
items.sanskrit: karaṇagaṇasaṃpramoṣaḥ smṛtināśaḥ śvāsakalilatā cchedaḥ | marmasu rujāviśeṣāḥ śarīrasaṃskārajo bhogaḥ

items.c2: Embodied — how's he gonna be otherwise? Deluded and all — still, at death-time the knower don't fall off self-truth.

choices.why: not-falling kept gripping; double negative street

items.sanskrit: sa kathaṃ vigrahayoge sati na bhavet tena mohayoge 'pi | maraṇāvasare jñānī na cyavate svātmaparamārthāt

items.c2: This truth-path, quick — got it straight from the teacher's mouth, grace falling hardest — then, no blocks: Śiva.
items.sanskrit: paramārthamārgam enaṃ jhaṭiti yadā gurumukhāt samabhyeti | atitīvraśaktipātāt tadaiva nirvighnam eva śivaḥ

items.c2: Form crossed over everything, step by step resorted — root in supreme truth gained, and at the end: made Śiva.

choices.why: all-crossed as gone past it all

items.sanskrit: sarvottīrṇaṃ rūpaṃ sopānapadakrameṇa saṃśrayataḥ | paratattvarūḍhilābhe paryante śivamayībhāvaḥ

items.c2: But his truth-stream, not reached, resting halfway — mind still hungry for that step — death can still come calling.

choices.why: stream kept flowing; path as current
death-may-be as caller at the door

items.sanskrit: tasya tu paramārthamayīṃ dhārām agatasya madhyaviśrānteḥ | tatpadalābhotsukacetaso 'pi maraṇaṃ kadācit syāt

items.c2: Fall off yoga and the books still rate him lord of wonder-worlds and all their joys. Rest on his stage-power, come back — next birth, turning Śiva.

choices.why: books call him; rating kept textual

items.sanskrit: yogabhraṣṭaḥ śāstre kathito 'sau citrabhogabhuvanapatiḥ | viśrāntisthānavaśād bhūtvā janmāntare śivībhavati

items.c2: Keep at this truth-path, miss the yoga proper, just by name even — god-world joys, glad mind, he enjoys himself long.
items.sanskrit: paramārthamārgam enaṃ hy abhyasyāprāpya yogam api nāma | suralokabhogabhāgī muditamanā modate suciram

items.c2: An emperor gets king's honours off all the people for his patch. Same: the yoga-fallen gets honoured by every god in every world.
items.sanskrit: viṣayeṣu sārvabhaumaḥ sarvajanaiḥ pūjyate yathā rājā | bhuvaneṣu sarvadaivaiḥ yogabhraṣṭas tathā pūjyaḥ

items.c2: Long time after, human again, yoga practised — he gets the divine deathless. And from there? No turning back.
items.sanskrit: mahatā kālena punar mānuṣyaṃ prāpya yogam abhyasya | prāpnoti divyam amṛtam yasmād āvartate na punaḥ

items.c2: So whoever rides this true path, devoted — he's headed Śiva-ward. Think that, and in truth? Keep striving.
items.sanskrit: tasmāt sanmārge 'smin nirato yaḥ kaścid eti sa śivatvam | iti matvā paramārthe yathā tathāpi prayatanīyam

items.c2: Turn over this supreme brahman, brief as Abhinavagupta told it. Soon — Śiva-ness moves into his own heart's rooms.

choices.why: meditation as handling; brief kept short

items.sanskrit: idam abhinavaguptoditasaṃkṣepaṃ dhyāyataḥ paraṃ brahma | acirād eva śivatvam nijahṛdayāveśam abhyeti

items.c2: Hundred āryās. That's the whole teaching-essence, condensed, deep-cover. Told by Abhinavagupta — by me — lit by remembering Śiva's feet.
items.sanskrit: tad idaṃ saṃkṣiptaṃ śāstrasāram atigūḍham | abhinavaguptena mayā śivacaraṇasmaraṇadīptena
